biorxiv.name: bioRxiv
biorxiv.full_name: bioRxiv - The Preprint Server for Biology
biorxiv.description: Free online archive and distribution service for unpublished preprints in the life sciences.

medrxiv.name: medRxiv
medrxiv.full_name: medRxiv - The Preprint Server for Health Sciences
medrxiv.description: Free online archive and distribution server for complete but unpublished manuscripts (preprints) in the medical, clinical, and related health sciences.

bioinformatics.name: Bioinformatics
bioinformatics.description: Computational molecular biology covering new algorithms, software, databases, and analyses of biological data.

nucleic_acids_research.name: Nucleic Acids Research
nucleic_acids_research.description: Leading research in nucleic acids, including their chemistry, biology, and applications, and computational and structural studies of nucleic acids and their interactions.

arxiv.name: arXiv
arxiv.full_name: arXiv - Open-access archive for scholarly articles
arxiv.description: Free distribution service and open-access archive for preprints in physics, mathematics, computer science, quantitative biology, quantitative finance, statistics, and more.

nature.name: Nature
nature.full_name: Nature - International weekly journal of science
nature.description: Weekly multidisciplinary journal publishing peer-reviewed research of outstanding significance across all fields of science and technology, alongside news and commentary.

nature_biotech.name: Nature Biotechnology
nature_biotech.description: Publishes peer-reviewed research and analysis on the science and business of biotechnology, covering the application of biological systems to therapeutics, diagnostics, agriculture, and related areas.

nature_methods.name: Nature Methods
nature_methods.description: Publishes peer-reviewed novel methods and significant improvements to techniques across the life sciences, including their development, validation, and application.

cell.name: Cell
cell.description: Cell Press flagship journal publishing high-impact peer-reviewed research across the full breadth of the life sciences.

cell_systems.name: Cell Systems
cell_systems.description: Cell Press journal publishing research in systems biology, including quantitative, computational, and theoretical approaches to understanding biological systems across scales.

cell_genomics.name: Cell Genomics
cell_genomics.description: Open-access Cell Press journal publishing research across genetics and genomics, including functional, evolutionary, and computational genomics and their applications to health and disease.

plos_compbio.name: PLOS Computational Biology
plos_compbio.description: Open-access journal publishing research that applies computational methods to understand living systems across all scales, from molecules to ecosystems.

genome_biology.name: Genome Biology
genome_biology.description: Open-access journal publishing peer-reviewed research and methods across all areas of biology and biomedicine studied from a genomic and post-genomic perspective.

bmc_bioinformatics.name: BMC Bioinformatics
bmc_bioinformatics.description: BMC Bioinformatics is an open access, peer-reviewed journal that considers articles describing novel computational algorithms and software, models and tools, including statistical methods, machine learning and artificial intelligence, for the modelling and analysis of all kinds of biological data, as well as systems biology.

science.name: Science
science.full_name: Science - American Association for the Advancement of Science (AAAS)
science.description: Peer-reviewed flagship journal of the American Association for the Advancement of Science (AAAS), publishing significant original research across all scientific disciplines along with news and commentary.

science_advances.name: Science Advances
science_advances.full_name: Science Advances - American Association for the Advancement of Science (AAAS)
science_advances.description: AAAS open-access multidisciplinary journal publishing peer-reviewed original research across the physical, life, social, and computer sciences and engineering.

science_immunology.name: Science Immunology
science_immunology.full_name: Science Immunology - American Association for the Advancement of Science (AAAS)
science_immunology.description: AAAS journal publishing peer-reviewed original research across immunology in all organisms and model systems, spanning molecular, cellular, and translational immunology.

science_robotics.name: Science Robotics
science_robotics.full_name: Science Robotics - American Association for the Advancement of Science (AAAS)
science_robotics.description: AAAS journal publishing peer-reviewed original research on advances in robotics and related disciplines, including robot design, control, autonomy, and applications.

science_signaling.name: Science Signaling
science_signaling.full_name: Science Signaling - American Association for the Advancement of Science (AAAS)
science_signaling.description: AAAS journal publishing peer-reviewed original research on cellular signaling and regulatory networks, including signal transduction, systems biology, and relevance to disease.

science_translational_medicine.name: Science Translational Medicine
science_translational_medicine.full_name: Science Translational Medicine - American Association for the Advancement of Science (AAAS)
science_translational_medicine.description: AAAS journal publishing peer-reviewed original research that bridges basic science and clinical medicine to advance human health.

aaai_2027.name: AAAI 2027
aaai_2027.full_name: The Association for the Advancement of Artificial Intelligence
aaai_2027.description: Promote research in Artificial Intelligence (AI) and foster scientific exchange between researchers, practitioners, scientists, students, and engineers across the entirety of AI and its affiliated disciplines.

iclr_2027.name: ICLR 2027
iclr_2027.full_name: The Fifteenth International Conference on Learning Representations
iclr_2027.description: Conference on representation learning, deep learning, and their applications, covering machine learning theory, methods, and practice.

discrete_mathematics.name: Discrete Mathematics
discrete_mathematics.description: Elsevier journal publishing original research and survey articles across combinatorics, graph theory, and the broader field of discrete mathematics.

combinatorica.name: Combinatorica
combinatorica.description: International journal publishing research in combinatorics and the theory of computing, including combinatorial structures, optimization, algorithms, complexity, geometry, and number theory.
